# Oligarchy cards

<!-- Generated from the engine code by `make docs`: do not edit by hand. -->

Oligarchy cards are consumables: elite capital, public code (spectral cards, in
the original). Powerful, at a price. The shop never sells them: they come from
oligarchy packs, which draw a hand from the deck, and from a few jokers.
Aspiring Billionaire and Praise the Oligarchy are rare (0.3% each); Aspiring
Billionaire is the only way to get a legendary joker.

| Id | Card | Effect | Cards | Quip |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `board_appointment` | Board Appointment | Destroys 1 random card in hand, adds 3 enhanced face cards | hand | *Three new directors. All related.* |
| `hostile_takeover` | Hostile Takeover | Destroys 1 random card in hand, adds 2 enhanced aces | hand | *Everything belongs to us now.* |
| `hiring_spree` | Hiring Spree | Destroys 1 random card in hand, adds 4 enhanced numbered cards | hand | *Four interns, no onboarding.* |
| `golden_handshake` | Golden Handshake | Adds a Gold Star seal to 1 selected card | 1 | *Signed, sealed, overpaid.* |
| `oligarchy_theme` | Oligarchy Theme | Gives 1 selected card Blur, Shadow or Animated | 1 | *Funny, but good enough to ship.* |
| `leveraged_buyout` | Leveraged Buyout | Creates a random AUR joker; sets money to $0 |  | *Bought with your money. All of it.* |
| `monopoly` | Monopoly | Every card in hand takes a single random suit | hand | *One suit to rule them all.* |
| `consolidation` | Consolidation | Every card in hand takes a single random rank; −1 hand size | hand | *Fewer choices. Same price.* |
| `offshore_account` | Offshore Account | Gives a random joker Transparent; −1 hand size |  | *Invisible to the taxman.* |
| `mass_layoffs` | Mass Layoffs | Destroys 5 random cards in hand; +$20 | hand | *Synergy achieved. Here's $20.* |
| `merger` | Merger | Copies a random joker; destroys all the others |  | *Two of the same, none of the rest.* |
| `oligarchy_harness` | Oligarchy Harness | Adds a Retry seal to 1 selected card | 1 | *Every release, vetted twice by agents.* |
| `restructuring` | Restructuring | Gives a random joker Animated; destroys all the others |  | *One survivor, now with animations.* |
| `brand_guidelines` | Brand Guidelines | Adds a Theme Sync seal to 1 selected card | 1 | *Every slide in the corporate theme.* |
| `surveillance` | Surveillance | Adds a Shell History seal to 1 selected card | 1 | *Recorded for quality purposes.* |
| `stock_split` | Stock Split | Adds 2 copies of 1 selected card to the deck | 1 | *Same value, twice the shares.* |
| `aspiring_billionaire` | Aspiring Billionaire | Creates a legendary joker |  | *#AspiringBillionaires* |
| `praise_the_oligarchy` | Praise the Oligarchy | Levels up every poker hand type |  | *A million here, a million there.* |
